title_zh: 约定删除虚构报道中未经证实的身份标签

scenario.label_zh: 约定删除虚构报道中未经证实的身份标签
scenario.goal_zh: 区分图片说明中的军队位置与袭击归责，并约定删除没有证据支持的恐怖主义标签

context_zh: 课堂使用完全虚构的地图、图片与报道片段练习核对证据，不涉及现实政治事件。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I've labelled the rider in this picture a terrorist. The exercise says there was an attack nearby.

sentences.speaker: Tutor Ellis
sentences.text: Does any of the material identify that rider as taking part in the attack?

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: No. The caption only identifies a cavalry troop in the northern territory.

sentences.speaker: Tutor Ellis
sentences.text: Then a location isn't evidence of responsibility. And the background note says the investigators haven't established a motive.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: So I can't describe the incident as terrorism on the basis of this picture.

sentences.speaker: Tutor Ellis
sentences.text: Correct. Report what the exercise actually gives you, and keep the unknowns visible.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I'll remove that label from the rider and the claim about the incident. I'll keep the caption's location and say responsibility hasn't been established.
